name: Kneaders Bakery & Café (Draper / Riverton-Herriman / Orem / Logan) Turkey Bacon Avocado on Focaccia or Chunky Cinnamon French Toast
brandOrRestaurant: Kneaders Bakery & Café (Draper / Riverton / Orem / Logan, UT)
whyItWorks: With locations in Draper, Riverton/Herriman, Orem (near BambooHR), and Logan, Kneaders' hand-pulled slow-roasted real turkey breast with provolone and avocado on soft rosemary-free focaccia/sourdough bread is one of Utah's best everyday sandwiches.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Slow-Roasted Turkey, Bacon & Avocado Sandwich on sourdough or focaccia with provolone (ask for no raw red onion or lettuce, and sauce on the side).
watchOuts: If ordering Kneaders' famous Chunky Cinnamon French Toast for breakfast, ask for caramel/cream syrup on the side, skip seeded strawberries, and take lactase
